facts.statement: §4.2(E) NBDD-CZ: on-site development limited to single-family on a minimum 5,800 sq ft lot or B&B inns at 32.5 units/acre (subject lot 3,146 sq ft = 54%); §4.2E.4 lets an owner instead dedicate the lot as open space and transfer rights at 32.5 du/acre to NBDD-DZ.
facts.quote: single-family residential development with a minimum lot size of 5,800 square feet
facts.design_effect: Buildability gate; TDR is the fallback; title must show no dedication already burdens Lot 20.

facts.statement: No snippet returned any NBDD-CZ height (feet or stories) or setback figure; 33 ft / 3 stories and 25 ft front / 15 ft-or-15% rear / 7.5 ft sides remain unverified assumptions; the only confirmed §4.2(E) design rule is that setback areas must keep visual access to the beach free of opaque fences, sheds and canopies.
facts.design_effect: Placeholders only (25 x 40 ft by-right footprint vs 30 x 55 ft target); side/rear setbacks stay visually open (glass/picket rails).

facts.statement: §4.23: side yard 7.5 ft 'except for platted lots of 50 feet or less, the setback is 5 feet'; a §4.2 rule: '3 stories and above = 20 ft + 5 ft per floor above the second; except lots of 6,500 sq ft or less, 5 ft'; which governs NBDD-CZ is unknown.
facts.design_effect: Both lot-size exceptions point to 5 ft sides (30 ft envelope); 7.5 ft gives 25 ft.

facts.statement: No 'or as platted' / lot-of-record exception found; a §3.x snippet makes sites 'platted and developed prior to the effective date' legal nonconforming (multifamily context), not clearly covering a never-built vacant lot; Article 5 variance criteria unread.
facts.design_effect: Carry by-right vs variance branches plus a fallback scheme inside the by-right envelope.

facts.statement: §2.2 reportedly defines HEIGHT OF A BUILDING from the 'established grade of the plot' to the highest point of a flat roof (mean of eaves/ridge if pitched); a §4.6 snippet (Beach CRA/RAC/TOC) uses 'median established grade' (average of highest and lowest) excluding parapets; 'established grade' itself was never retrieved; no source measures from BFE/DFE or crown.
facts.corrected_statement: Refuter: unverifiable, not contradicted; datum may be crown, natural grade or a flood elevation; §4.2(E) may override; §4.6 wording's section and currency unconfirmed.
facts.quote: The vertical distance from the established grade of the plot upon which a building is located to the highest point of the roof surface
facts.design_effect: A plot-grade datum makes the flood-mandated parking level consume 6-7 ft of the budget; parapets appear excluded.

facts.statement: The ZLDR 'story' definition and any exclusion of a breakaway parking level were not retrieved; FBC-B Ch. 2 makes an at-grade parking level whose next floor is > 6 ft above grade plane a 'story above grade plane' (building code only); no freeboard height exclusion found, Ch. 154 unreadable.
facts.design_effect: If the garage level counts, garage + 3 living floors = 4 stories against an assumed 3-story cap.

facts.statement: On ASSUMED inputs (BFE 10.0 ft NAVD88, grade 5.5 ft, 33 ft cap): lowest member >= 11.0 ft, first floor ~12.0 ft NAVD; 3 x 10 ft + 1 ft roof = 37.5 ft above grade (fails a grade datum by ~4.5 ft; 34.5 ft at 9 ft floor-to-floor) but 31 ft above the DFE floor (fits, ~2 ft margin); 2 stories = 27.5 ft; clearance under BFE+1 girders only ~3-6 ft, short of ~7 ft for a garage.
facts.design_effect: Case A (grade): 2 stories + roof deck or 3 compressed; Case B (DFE): 3 stories; budget +1 to +4 ft for a usable garage.

facts.statement: §154.50 (snippet): residential lowest floor at the FBC elevation 'or at least 18 inches above the highest point of the crown of all streets adjacent to the plot' (nonresidential 6 in); MEP at or above BFE + 1 ft; space below limited to parking/access/storage; amended O-2020-04, O-2021-17; no city freeboard above FBC found.
facts.corrected_statement: Refuter: unverifiable, not contradicted; 'or' vs 'higher governs' unknown; for a VE lot R322.3.2 and FDEP's 100-yr storm elevation may govern; 'no local freeboard' is an unconfirmed negative.
facts.design_effect: Crown+18 in likely governs only the garage slab and apron; MEP at or above BFE+1.

facts.statement: Staff reports: §4.22(E) lists 'building elements that are exempt from the height regulations in all districts, including provisions for scenery lofts'; the ZLDR 'currently limit[s] scenery lofts to a maximum roof coverage area of 10% of the ground floor area' (open-air, opaque cover, not 'additional habitable space'); more needs a variance: 501 S Surf Rd (BWK-25-HD-R) sought 41% = 1,369.04 sf on 3,335.70 sf (staff supported: no adverse impact, no visual incompatibility), an RS-6 case 14.2%, 24-V-45 at 5405; the exempt-element list, feet caps and whether bulkheads (~120-160 sf) count inside the 10% were not retrieved; penthouses must be 'enclosed and screened' as integral design.
facts.corrected_statement: Refuter: unverifiable, not contradicted; 10% is staff paraphrase, not code text; 'by right' and NBDD-CZ applicability are inferences (24-V-45 wording only); the screening rule creates no exemption.
facts.design_effect: By-right covered roof ~165 sf on 1,650 sf; variant A (bulkheads only) vs B (covered area via variance, screened); hold >= 42 in reserve.

facts.statement: A §4.6 snippet (RAC/DBCRD/TOC) exempts 'vertical projections not intended for human occupation' (parapets, vertical circulation, elevator bulkheads) and lets covered rooftop amenities exceed height on <= 30% of gross rooftop area; agents infer §4.6 does not govern NBDD-CZ; no ZLDR text on rooftop pools, coping, weirs or guards vs height was found.
facts.corrected_statement: Refuter: unverifiable, not contradicted; section scope and non-applicability to NBDD-CZ unconfirmed; '§4.22(E) governs instead' is an unsourced inference.
facts.design_effect: Do not rely on the 30% rule; treat an occupied roof pool as height-generating; fallback: recess the shell 3.5-4 ft into the Level 3 ceiling.

facts.statement: §4.23 reportedly lets listed features project into a required yard up to 25% of the yard, max 6 ft, some 'Not permitted in the front yard' (list not retrieved); §155.12: no fence height limit stated in front yards except view triangles, secondary sources cite 4 ft front / 6 ft side-rear; §4.1/§9.4: >= 20% of required front yard pervious, 1 tree per 1,250 sf, natives >= 60%/50%; no lot-coverage cap found; ZLDR is on amlegal, not Municode.
facts.corrected_statement: Refuter: unverifiable, not contradicted; amlegal hosting and §4.23's exact title unconfirmed.
facts.design_effect: No balconies assumed over the N Surf Rd yard (max 1.25 ft into 5 ft sides); front yard >= 20% planted with a canopy tree.

facts.statement: §7.1: single-family may park with direct street access and tandem spaces; driveway min 12 ft one-way / 24 ft two-way (12 ft two-way for < 8 spaces with recorded covenant), 3 ft from side lot line; space 8.5 x 18 ft; garage rear setback 20 ft, 10 ft for lots <= 100 ft; §7.2 count not retrieved (commonly 2) and the Beach CRA treats 1.5 spaces as a MAXIMUM for single-family (501 S Surf variance 1.5 -> 5); NBDD-CZ cap unknown.
facts.design_effect: Four 8.5 x 18 ft spaces (34 ft) will not fit a 30 ft footprint; only a 2x2 tandem bay (~17-19 x 36-40 ft, ~700-800 sf) works; count variance possible.

facts.statement: §4.23: pool setbacks to water's edge rear 6 ft, side 6 ft, street side 15 ft; not in front yard or easements; fence with self-closing locking gate >= 42 in (Ch. 158.04 defers to the 48 in FBC barrier); open uncovered pools/decks excluded from the 30% rear-yard accessory cap; City pool handout (Feb 2022): separate barrier permit, retaining wall where pool grade exceeds neighbors'.
facts.design_effect: If applied to a roof pool (unknown), 6 ft side setbacks cap pool width at 28 ft, 1 ft inboard of a 30 ft building.

facts.statement: FBC-R R322.3.3.1: V-zone pools designed per ASCE 24; R322.1.6: electrical, HVAC, plumbing fixtures, ducts and service equipment at or above the required elevation, never on breakaway walls; pool equipment may be lower only if elevated as practical, anchored and GFCI-protected; elevator shafts exempt from breakaway/opening rules but must meet ASCE 24 (FBC-B 3109.3.4); TB4/ASCE 24 §7.5 (machinery above DFE, cab float switch) not fetched.

facts.statement: CCCL position vs the lot unverified (FDEP layers blocked; agents infer the lot is wholly seaward). F.S. 161.053 (2025 text via mirror): no structure or grade change seaward of the CCCL without DEP authorization; DEP may permit along the adjacent 'line of construction' but may not contravene equal-or-stricter local setbacks; DEP may condition timing and require turtle lighting plans (Hollywood ordinance reported §108/O-2011-07, Mar 1-Oct 31); DEP permit precedes the City permit (FBC-B 3109.1.2); 90-day clock for individual permits, 30 days' notice for general permits; no local delegation found; no height cap.
facts.quote: the department may not contravene setback requirements or zoning or building codes established by a county or municipality
facts.design_effect: Survey ties to CCCL/ECL/30-yr line; seaward face at or landward of 5781/5789's; FDEP first (>= 90 days); shielded amber lighting.

facts.statement: F.S. 161.053(5)(b): no permit for anything but shore-protection structures, minor structures or piers where projected seaward of the seasonal high-water line (150% of mean tidal range above MHW) within 30 years; (5)(c) single-family exception if platted pre-section, no adjacent landward parcel owned, landward of the frontal dune and 'as far landward on its parcel as is practicable'; (5)(d) nourishment seaward of the ECL excluded; whether the line crosses this lot is unknown.
facts.design_effect: If the 30-yr line bites, FDEP pushes the house to the minimum front setback; keep the massing able to slide west.

facts.statement: F.S. 161.54(6): swimming pools and parking garages are 'nonhabitable major structures', not 'minor structures' (walkovers, pile decks, fences, driveways), so a ground pool must be landward of the 30-yr line; 161.053(18)(a) allows general permits for single-family houses with associated pools not advancing the line of construction; FBC-B 3109 covers only habitable structures, so pool criteria come from DEP conditions (62B-33.005/.0051, 62B-34 unread); no source addresses rooftop pools.
facts.design_effect: Roof pool avoids dune excavation but needs a written FDEP pre-application answer; a ground pool must clear the 30-yr line.

facts.statement: FBC-B 2023 §3109 (mirror): habitable structures seaward of the CCCL on piles/columns only (no shallow foundations or stemwalls), pile spacing-to-diameter >= 8:1, grade beams at/below eroded design grade; lowest member at or above the higher of the ASCE 24, jurisdiction or FDEP 100-yr storm elevation (1999 report); ASCE 24 §4.6 breakaway walls with flood openings; shear walls shore-perpendicular (+/-20 deg) else <= 20% of shore-parallel length; enclosures below limited to parking/access/storage; R322.1.11: more restrictive governs.
facts.quote: shallow foundations and stemwalls are not permitted
facts.design_effect: Shore-parallel shear walls limited to ~6 ft on a 30 ft width: lateral system east-west, open piles or moment frames north-south.

facts.statement: FEMA zone, panel and BFE not obtained; inferred Zone VE, BFE ~9-12 ft NAVD88 (placeholder 10.0); FIRM date conflict: 12011C 'H' panels effective Aug 18, 2014 (third-party dataset) vs Broward FIRMs 'effective July 31, 2024, NAVD88' (broward.org snippet); no Broward building freeboard above FBC (Ch. 39 Art. XXV's 5 ft NAVD88 crest is for seawalls/berms).
facts.design_effect: Publish the height stack as a sensitivity table (BFE 9/10/11/12 ft; freeboard +1/+2 ft).

facts.statement: FBC-R 2023 R322.3.2 (two mirrors agree verbatim): in V and Coastal A zones the bottom of the lowest horizontal structural member (excluding piles, pile caps, columns, grade beams, bracing) must be at or above BFE + 1 ft or DFE, whichever higher; basements and structural fill prohibited; R322.3.3: pilings/columns per ASCE 24 with scour.
facts.corrected_statement: Substantive (medium confidence): R322.2.1's lowest-floor rule applies to A zones 'not including ... Coastal A Zones' in Florida, so the original claim mis-scoped it; BFE+1 ft stands; hollywoodfl.org's 'FFE at BFE plus one foot' is unverified and imprecise for V zones.
facts.quote: elevated to or above the base flood elevation plus 1 foot (305 mm) or the design flood elevation, whichever is higher
facts.design_effect: Parking-level height is fixed by flood elevation plus 1-2 ft girder depth; first floor ~6-7 ft above grade at the assumed BFE.

facts.statement: FBC-R R322.3.5/.6, R322.2.2, 44 CFR 60.3(e): space below the required elevation solely for parking, access or storage; walls non-structural, lattice/screen or breakaway 10-20 psf (engineered collapse where wind > 20 psf) with flood openings 1 sq in/sq ft, >= 2 sides, sill <= 1 ft; slabs frangible (<= 4 in, unreinforced, isolation joints at piles) or engineered; stairs open-riser/breakaway/retractable/flood-resistant, R609 door atop a breakaway-enclosed stair; detached accessory <= 100 sf; NFIP rating breakpoint 300 sf.
facts.design_effect: No bathroom or finished room at parking level; garage doors engineered breakaway/vented; enclosure limited to the tandem bay.

facts.statement: F.S. 161.191: a recorded ECL vests seaward title in the State and freezes the upland boundary against accretion/erosion; 161.181 records the survey in the county plat book; 161.201 bars structures seaward of the ECL except erosion-prevention works; a ZLDR §2.2 snippet (zoneomics) makes the Atlantic boundary the ECL except Broadwalk-adjacent lots; whether a Broward Segment II ECL bounds this lot is unverified.

facts.statement: Pool 10 x 20 x 4 ft: 800 cu ft = 5,984 gal = 49,920 lb = 249.6 psf; baja shelf 1,872 lb (46.8 psf); total 51,792 lb (25.9 tons) = 215.8 psf over 240 sf; with shell ~110,000 lb (~450-460 psf; ~27.5 kips per support on 4 points); 14.5% of a 1,650 sf footprint; vs FBC-R roof live load 20 psf, floors 30-40, garages 50, FBC-B 1607.1 assembly roofs 100 psf; HVHZ wind Broward RC II 170 mph (I 156, III 180, IV 185), Exposure C min (D possible), ASCE 7 Ch. 29; ASTM E1996 Zone 3/4; pool projects ~5.2-5.5 ft above the roof slab unless recessed ~3.5-4 ft into the Level 3 ceiling; infinity edge adds a 2-3 ft catch basin.

height_datum_conclusion: Only snippets exist: ZLDR §2.2 'HEIGHT OF A BUILDING' from the 'established grade of the plot' to the highest point of a flat roof, and a §4.6 (Beach CRA/RAC/TOC) rule from 'median established grade' excluding parapets; 'established grade' itself, any NBDD-CZ datum, the 'story' definition and any freeboard height exclusion were never retrieved, and no source says Hollywood measures from BFE/DFE or crown of road. Neither the 33 ft nor the 3-story cap was found; FBC-B Ch. 2 would count the parking level as a 'story above grade plane' for building-code purposes only. §154.50 (snippet) sets the residential lowest floor at the FBC elevation 'or at least 18 inches above the highest point of the crown of all streets adjacent to the plot', MEP at BFE+1 ft, space below limited to parking/access/storage; FBC-R R322.3.2 fixes the bottom of the lowest horizontal member at BFE+1 ft or DFE in VE/Coastal A, and FBC-B 3109.3.3 can raise it to FDEP's 100-yr storm elevation. Assumed-input arithmetic (BFE 10.0 ft NAVD88, grade 5.5 ft, 33 ft cap): lowest member >= 11.0 ft, first floor ~12.0 ft NAVD (6.5 ft above grade); three 10 ft stories + 1 ft roof = 43.0 ft NAVD = 37.5 ft above grade, failing a grade datum by ~4.5 ft (34.5 ft at 9 ft floor-to-floor) but only 31 ft above the DFE floor (fits, ~2 ft margin); two stories over parking = 27.5 ft (fits, ~5.5 ft spare). Verdict: three residential stories over parking fit within 33 ft only if Hollywood measures from BFE/DFE or excludes mandated freeboard, neither of which was found; carry Case A (grade: 2 stories + roof deck, or 3 compressed 9 ft stories) and Case B (DFE: 3 stories) until a written zoning determination (Hollywood Planning, Cameron Palmer), the FIRM BFE, a site/crown survey and Ch. 154 text are in hand; the ~3-6 ft clearance under BFE+1 girders implies a further 1-4 ft rise for a usable garage, worsening Case A.

Snippet-level only: PDB File 24-V-45 (minutes Legistar ID 1205519, reported July 9, 2024, presenter Cameron Palmer) was a 'variance to the permitted height exemptions for covered rooftop areas greater than 10% of the ground floor area for a single-family house in the North Beach Development District-Control Zone', approved; vote reported as unanimous (Stadlen/Blattner) or 7-2 (Crawford/Blattner; Stadlen, Glickman opposed); no approved %, sf or conditions readable. A 5-page staff report dated Aug 12, 2025 (Legistar ID 14554393) exists, inferred but unread to be a 10% -> 39% request (449 sf on 1,135 sf ground floor); outcome unknown. NOT found: the claimed March 2023 five variances (setbacks, parking, height projections, ~3,635 sf house), the '25% -> 29% of building height' item (metric is % of ground-floor area), stories, elevation over parking, rooftop pool, permit status.

cccl.summary: CCCL position unverified (FDEP layers blocked); agents infer the lot is wholly seaward of it. F.S. 161.053 (2025 text, verified via mirror): no structure seaward of the CCCL without DEP authorization; DEP may permit along the adjacent 'line of construction' but cannot contravene equal-or-stricter local setbacks; the 30-year erosion projection bars all but shore-protection structures, minor structures and piers seaward of the projected seasonal high-water line (150% of mean tidal range above MHW), with a single-family exception (pre-existing plat, no adjacent landward parcel, landward of the frontal dune, 'as far landward on its parcel as is practicable'); nourishment seaward of the ECL excluded; no height cap. Foundations (FBC-B 3109): piles/columns only, lowest member above the higher of ASCE 24, jurisdiction or FDEP 100-yr storm elevation (1999 report; Broward values unverified), breakaway walls, shear walls shore-perpendicular or <= 20% of shore-parallel length. Pools are 'nonhabitable major structures' (F.S. 161.54(6)(c)): a ground pool must be landward of the 30-yr line; single-family houses with associated pools not advancing the line of construction may use a general permit (30 days' notice); FBC-B 3109 covers only habitable structures so pool criteria come from DEP conditions; no FDEP policy on rooftop pools found. Turtle lighting ordinance (reported §108, O-2011-07) applies Mar 1-Oct 31; DEP may require a lighting plan. Timelines: 90-day DEP action on a complete individual application (waivable), 30-day GP notice; DEP permit precedes the City permit; no local delegation found.

flood.summary: No FIRM panel, zone or BFE obtained; inferred VE, BFE ~9-12 ft NAVD88 (placeholder 10.0); FIRM date conflict (12011C 'H' effective Aug 18, 2014 vs Broward FIRMs effective July 31, 2024). Freeboard: FBC-R R322.3.2 (verified) puts the bottom of the lowest horizontal member in V/Coastal A at BFE+1 ft or DFE, whichever higher (R322.2.1 covers only non-coastal A zones in Florida); §154.50 (snippet) adds lowest floor >= street crown + 18 in and MEP >= BFE+1; no Hollywood or Broward freeboard beyond FBC found (Ch. 154 unread). Enclosures (R322.3.5/.6, R322.2.2, 44 CFR 60.3(e)): parking, access or storage only; non-structural lattice or breakaway walls 10-20 psf (engineered collapse where wind > 20 psf) with flood openings 1 sq in/sq ft, >= 2 sides, sill <= 1 ft; frangible <= 4 in slabs or engineered slabs; no structural fill; open-riser/breakaway/retractable stairs with an R609 door atop a breakaway-enclosed stair; detached accessory <= 100 sf; NFIP rating breakpoint 300 sf. Elevators: shafts exempt from breakaway/opening rules but must meet ASCE 24 (TB4/§7.5 details not fetched). Equipment (R322.1.6): all MEP and plumbing fixtures at or above the elevation, never on breakaway walls; pool equipment may be lower if elevated, anchored and GFCI; a parking-level bathroom is not permitted. Garage: a ~700-800 sf 4-car breakaway enclosure is permissible in principle (premium impact); clearance under BFE+1 girders is only ~3-6 ft, so the building likely rises 1-4 ft; ASCE 24-14 is paywalled and unverified.

property.summary: Listing (MLS #B26061057, snippets only): Lot #20 Hollywood Central Beach, 40 x 80 ft, 40.00 ft frontage, 3,146 sq ft (0.07 ac), NBDD-CZ, vacant direct-oceanfront, listed Aug 6, 2026 at $600,000, last sold Oct 17, 2018; remarks: uses 'may include a single-family residence or a bed-and-breakfast'. BCPA (folio 514201027042) could not be opened: block, plat book/page, use code, land calc and sales history unknown. Discrepancy: 40 x 80 = 3,200 sf vs 3,146 sf (54 sf, 1.7%) resolves to exactly 40 x 78.65 ft; cause unresolved; design to ~78.6 ft and require a survey tying plat line, ECL and CCCL. ECL: F.S. 161.181/.191/.201 (verified) fix a recorded ECL as the permanent seaward title line and bar structures seaward of it; a ZLDR §2.2 snippet says the Atlantic boundary is the ECL except Broadwalk lots; whether a Broward Segment II ECL crosses this lot is unverified. Neighbors 5781-5791: no records at all (stories, year built, elevation over parking unknown).

structure_pool.summary: Loads (verified arithmetic): basin 10 x 20 x 4 ft = 800 cu ft = 5,984 gal = 49,920 lb (249.6 psf); baja shelf 1,872 lb (46.8 psf); total 51,792 lb (25.9 tons), 215.8 psf over 240 sf; with shell and finishes ~110,000 lb (~450-460 psf, ~27.5 kips per support on four points); pool = 14.5% of a 1,650 sf footprint. Code baselines (cached FBC text): roof live load 20 psf vs assembly roofs 100 psf; water is fluid load F assumed full with deck live load and wind; HVHZ wind Broward RC II 170 mph, Exposure C minimum (D possible), ASCE 7 Ch. 29 for rooftop structures; ASTM E1996 Zone 3/4; V-zone piles and pools per ASCE 24. Seaward of the CCCL, FBC-B 3109 caps shore-parallel shear walls at 20% of length (6 ft on 30 ft), so the basin's long walls should run east-west on continuous column lines to the pile caps; 24-36 in transfer girders if offset. Geometry: a 4 ft pool sits ~5.2-5.5 ft above the roof slab unless recessed ~3.5-4 ft into the Level 3 ceiling; infinity edge adds a 2-3 ft catch basin; equipment room at or above the flood elevation. Precedents and costs: none sourced.

lot_size_minimum: Verified at snippet level (operative sentence repeated across independent snippets of §4.2(E)): NBDD-CZ single-family minimum lot size is 5,800 sq ft; the subject lot is 3,146 sq ft (54%, 2,654 sf short). No 'or as platted' or lot-of-record clause was found in any snippet of §4.2(E), §3.4/3.11/3.12 or §2.2; the only Article 3 text seen makes sites 'platted and developed prior to the effective date' legal nonconforming (multifamily context), which would not clearly cover a never-built vacant lot. G1 could open nothing; its only inference is that Florida codes commonly allow a dwelling on a pre-code platted lot in separate ownership, while the §4.2E.4 TDR option hints the City intended some CZ lots not to be built on. Article 5 variance criteria ('not self-created' prong) were not read; the platted pre-code dimensions are the strongest hardship argument, the 30 x 55 ft program the weakest; under the working setbacks a 30 x 55 envelope needs up to 5 relief items (area + front + rear + 2 sides). Fallback: dedicate under §4.2E.4 and sell 32.5 du/acre rights into NBDD-DZ.
contradictions: FIRM date: Broward FIRMs 'effective July 31, 2024, NAVD88' (broward.org snippet) vs 12011C suffix-H panels effective Aug 18, 2014 (third-party dataset).
Side setback: 7.5 ft floor vs 5 ft for platted lots <= 50 ft (§4.23) vs §4.2 '20 ft + 5 ft/floor above the second, except lots <= 6,500 sf = 5 ft'.
Height datum: §2.2 'established grade of the plot' vs §4.6 'median established grade' vs onlyplans.io 'grade or BFE+freeboard'; Case A (grade) fails 33 ft by ~4.5 ft, Case B (DFE) fits.
24-V-45 vote: 'passed unanimously' (Stadlen/Blattner) vs 'passed 7-2' (Crawford/Blattner; Stadlen, Glickman opposed), both attributed to the same multi-item minutes PDF.

5405 N Surf Rd: existing 946 sf 1932 house (listing) vs vacant (parcel mirror); built 1932 vs 1980; lot 3,146 vs 3,708 sf; the '25% -> 29% of building height' item is marked refuted by topic 1 but may be 24-V-45 itself per topic 3.
